tei:div.tei:p: When Thou in heaven turnest to the throne with the intent to warn and to chastise, then may Thine ear, Exalted One, listen to the sound of the Shofar that rises up from the earth. The punishment of that sentence no longer to dispute (with the generations of man before the flood) will not return to cause havoc; as for the world which four days each year is judged, support it in Thy grace and in Thy truth, O Lord. For battle are we gathered, against the stone of offence (evil inclination) do we battle; listen from the heights to the plaintive sound of the Teruah, exchange the throne of judgment for the throne of compassion. May the descendants of that only son who was summoned for sacrifice, be treated leniently in the course of justice; remember that plea: Far be it from Thee, O God of justice, not to administer justice. Though they as human beings have transgressed the Covenant, do Thou, as God, regard the Covenant; remove the threat of punishment of the Covenant since Thou rememberest the Covenant with the three forefathers.

When Thou dost examine the world on the day of the New Year, determine the year favourably, rich in fruit, dew and rain in the heat, so as to awaken to life from the grave through the dew of the year.
